title: Harness skill-update-pending: record learning before next delegation
desc: After a source file write, a lock arms requiring a skill update (record what was learned) before the next delegation, so the next blank agent does not start blind.
steps: TRIGGER: a wkappbot file write/edit (non-skill) arms the code_changed_skill_not_updated lock; the next Agent/wkcodex dispatch is blocked until it clears.

FIX: clear by recording the learning -- wkappbot skill edit <id> --add-step 'what changed/learned' (or 3 skill reads in the dispatch). Run the cleared dispatch as the very next call with no intervening source write.
WHY: code changed but knowledge did not = the successor agent starts blind. The lock forces knowledge to keep pace with code. See: claude-md-harness-rules, skill-contribute-edit.
author: claude
